title: Sebilite Protector
summary: Test the berserker's trial weapons against the Sebilite Protector while dealing with his guardians.
overview: Test the berserker's trial weapons against the Sebilite Protector while dealing with his guardians.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control the guardians and their healing while the questing berserker completes each weapon test.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The qualifying juggernaut kill checks the berserker's epic step and event cooldown before spawning the protector and two guardians.
At 75% health, the protector begins Death Shackles and signals the guardians into their spell cycle.
Guardians cast debuffs and repeatedly attempt Complete Heal on the protector.
The qualifying berserker must perform the weapon tests during combat; the encounter has a 30-minute despawn deadline.

notes: Approval E285. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
